notes: Company background: mid-market B2B SaaS for product usage analytics and in-app recommendations; heavily product-led growth, trial->paid conversion is key.
Initial ask: evaluate hosted API for fast time-to-value for embeddings + semantic search; potential move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost once POC passes.
Current infra: Postgres + pgvector for internal similarity store, nightly ETL that generates ~100k new vectors per day (peak), ~3M vectors current corpus.
Performance targets: query tail latency <= 100ms for 95th pct, steady-state query throughput ~300 qps for product search, ingestion batch: 200k vectors/hour during nightly job.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. PM stated: 'we need predictable unit economics once integrated; hosted is fine for POC but cannot run production spikes without cost predictability.'
Model preferences: open / quantized embedding models (cost-driven). Will accept 768-d or 1024-d embeddings if latency/cost tradeoff is favorable.

POC scope discussed: ingest 500k rows from their staging dataset into Redwood-hosted embedding pipeline, index into their pgvector instance, run 10k query load test and compare latency/cost to current baseline.
Security: require SSO for console access, SOC2 report review, audit logs for API keys, option for KMS-backed key management on Dedicated.
Integration notes: prefer using Redwood to return embeddings (hosted) and push to customer's vector DB, but also evaluating Redwood-managed index + serving if offers lower latency.
Operational asks: batch embeddings API with idempotency keys, resume/partial-fail semantics for large ETL, backfill tooling suggestions.
Pricing convo: asked for committed monthly capacity pricing vs pay-as-you-go; requested 12-month dedicated estimate with burst credits.
Quote from product lead: 'If we can get predictable 99th latency and a plan to avoid runaway token costs, we can move to committed capacity.'
Internal champions: Senior Product Lead (Emily Rhodes) and Head of Infra (Marco Diaz) — both in all calls.
Green flags: quick technical alignment with SE on integration patterns; demo showed ~60ms median for sample queries on hosted API during demo environment.
Risks: dataset contains PII for some customers — need explicit guidance on retention and deletion, legal asked for residency options for EU subset.
